note: Frozen before any test run. One yes/no question per catalogue issue, then general risk questions. Never tuned on test labels.

issues.OWNER_MISMATCH: Is any owner stated in the application missing from the company's beneficial-ownership (PSC) register?
issues.DIRECTOR_MISMATCH: Is any director stated in the application missing from the company's registered officers?
issues.DISQUALIFIED_DIRECTOR: Is any stated director or registered officer a disqualified director?
issues.STATUS_MISMATCH: Is the company dissolved, struck off or in liquidation as of the case date?
issues.SANCTIONS_HIT: Does any stated director or owner match a sanctions list entry?
issues.CLONED_WEBSITE: Does the website text look copied from another company's website rather than written for this business?
issues.ADDRESS_MASS_REG: Is the registered office a mass-registration address shared by more than 500 companies?
issues.NEW_DOMAIN: Was the website's domain created less than 30 days before the case date?
issues.ACTIVITY_MISMATCH: Does the stated industry disagree with the registered industry codes or with what the website describes?
issues.VOLUME_IMPLAUSIBLE: Is the expected monthly volume implausible for a company of this age and size?

general.real_operating_business: Does this look like a real, operating business rather than a shell or front?
general.control_concealed: Does the ownership or control of this company look deliberately obscured?
general.story_consistent: Is everything in the application consistent with the registry record and the website?
general.analyst_concern: Would an experienced KYB analyst have concerns about onboarding this business?
general.should_decline: Should this business be declined for onboarding?
